orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Everett Community Food Bank)
title: Food Bank Volunteer
description: Help provide food to local families in need at the Everett Community Food Bank.

title: General Volunteer (Greeter, Program Support, Kitchen, Reception)
description: Come help at the Lynnwood Neighborhood Center — roles include greeter, event duties, program support, resource center receptionist, and kitchen support.

orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Monroe Fairdays)
title: Monroe Fairdays Parade Volunteer
description: One-time event support for the Monroe Fairdays Parade.

orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Sky Valley)
title: Sky Valley Lunch Prep and Service
description: Assist with lunch preparation and service for the Sky Valley program.

orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Carl Gipson Center)
title: Membership Desk Volunteer
description: Support membership desk operations at the Carl Gipson Center.

orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Dispute Resolution Center)
title: Mediation Volunteer
description: Learn how to mediate conflict between parents, landlords/tenants, and other parties.

orgName: VOAWW Early Learning & Child Care (ECEAP Preschools)
title: ECEAP Preschool Classroom Support
description: Read to students, set up music classes, do art projects, update the garden or playground, or assist in the office.

orgName: Volunteers of America Western Washington (Sky Valley Youth Co)
title: Sky Valley Youth Co Mentor
description: Work directly with youth, helping them develop healthy relationships.

orgName: Boys & Girls Clubs of Snohomish County
title: Club Volunteer (National Programs, Sports Coaching, Jr. Staff)
description: Assist in running national programs, create and facilitate educational programs, coach sports teams, or act as junior staff. AmeriCorps volunteer roles also available.
requirements: Photo ID and email address required
Age 18+ (separate Minor Volunteer Application for under 18)

title: Front Desk / Donation Room Organizer
description: Create a welcoming space by greeting visitors, answering phones, assisting staff, and organizing donations at the Hub location.
requirements: Complete required orientation and training before beginning

title: Tech Center Volunteer
description: Provide hands-on support with activities like 3D printing, GED prep, and resume building to help youth develop skills and confidence.
requirements: Experience working with youth facing adversity

title: One-Time Event Volunteer
description: Support at community events including auction assistance, guest check-in, setup, cleanup, and ticket sales.

title: KidVantage Pickup Volunteer
description: Use your own vehicle to pick up a scheduled order of essential supplies and goods from KidVantage and deliver them to the Village on Casino Road.

title: Board of Directors Member
description: Support ChildStrive's mission through strategic direction, oversight, fundraising, and community partnership development.

title: Social Media Ambassador
description: Help amplify ChildStrive's mission to build successful futures for children and families through social media tasks.
commitment: 5-10 minutes per week, at least six months

title: Group & Individual Volunteer Projects
description: Kit assembly, family store organization, book cataloging, playground maintenance, garden weeding, graphic design, and data organization — for individuals, families, corporate groups, and large groups.

title: Volunteer with a 350 Seattle Team
description: 350 Seattle is an all-volunteer-run climate justice organization. Volunteers join one of several working teams (e.g., organizing/direct action, communications, fundraising, electoral/GOTV canvassing) depending on interests and skills; the org maintains a Volunteer Opportunities list and a Teams page to help match people to a role.

title: Executive Service Corps Consultant – Compensation Projects
description: Skilled professionals volunteer as consultants to nonprofits on compensation policy and analysis as part of 501 Commons' Executive Service Corps.

title: Executive Service Corps Consultant – Board Governance
description: Volunteer consultants help nonprofit boards and staff align by updating bylaws, drafting board manuals, providing governance training, and facilitating board discussions.
requirements: Nonprofit governance or board leadership experience

title: Volunteer Usher
description: Volunteers usher performances (arriving roughly two hours before curtain) in exchange for a seat to watch the show. Related front-of-house volunteer roles include Will Call, Front Desk, hosting pre-show "Show Talks," administrative support, special events, and community marketing.
commitment: Ongoing season; currently a waitlist (roughly a season-long wait)
requirements: Placed on waitlist via Volunteer Coordinator

title: Volunteer Usher
description: ACT (now operating as Union Arts Center) recruits volunteer ushers for front-of-house support during performances at the Eagles Auditorium.

title: Admin Support Volunteer
description: Helps keep Arboretum Foundation programs running behind the scenes through data entry, organizing materials, and filing.

title: Garden Steward
description: Assists staff gardeners with maintaining the Arboretum through weeding and mulching while learning plant identification.
commitment: No formal commitment; encouraged twice monthly, minimum 2 hours/session

title: Gift Shop Host
description: Staffs the Mary Ellen Mulder Arboretum Gift Shop, engaging with visitors, offering information, and operating the register.
commitment: Minimum 2 shifts/month for 6 months (1 shift/month for weekend volunteers)
requirements: Willing to learn Square POS system

title: Plant Program Volunteer
description: Grows, cares for, and learns about plants through propagation and nursery work in the Pat Calvert Greenhouse and Cloney-Harris Plant Nursery.
commitment: Ongoing, monthly expectations vary by placement
requirements: Ability to bend, lift, and stand

title: Events Volunteer
description: Supports Arboretum Foundation events with set-up/breakdown, cashiering, and silent auction support.
schedule: Throughout the year as events arise
requirements: Ability to assist with light-to-moderate physical tasks

title: Corporate/Group Work Party
description: Groups weed, remove invasive species, and complete mulching projects with staff guidance; tools provided.

title: Ongoing Program Volunteer
description: Longer-term volunteer roles supporting ACRS programs (e.g., food bank, community farm, front desk/reception, program support), with orientation and training provided.

title: One-Time Event & Food Bank Volunteer
description: Single-day volunteer opportunities supporting ACRS events, voter outreach/get-out-the-vote efforts, and the food bank.

title: AmeriCorps Member (Employment, Citizenship, or Children/Youth/Family Programs)
description: Full-time, stipended AmeriCorps service placements within ACRS's Employment, Citizenship, and Children/Youth/Family programs.

title: Bayview Manor Foundation Volunteer
description: Volunteer support for the Bayview Manor Foundation, which works alongside Bayview Manor Homes senior living community to raise gifts, bequests, and contributions that subsidize residents without financial resources.

title: Neighborhood Bird Project Volunteer
description: Conduct monthly bird counts along predetermined routes around local parks as part of community science monitoring.

title: Collision Monitoring Volunteer
description: Help monitor and document bird-window collisions to support prevention research.

title: Christmas Bird Count Volunteer
description: Participate in the longest-running community science bird survey in North America, held annually in December.

title: On-Site Docent Volunteer
description: Welcome visitors and guide them through exhibits at the Birds Connect Seattle space, answering conservation-related questions.

title: Field Trip / Neighborhood Bird Outing Leader
description: Plan and lead nature outings and bird walks for birders of all experience levels.
requirements: Enjoys sharing birds and nature with groups

title: Science and eBird Data Entry Volunteer
description: Transcribe paper bird-count datasheets into the online eBird database.

title: Board Member
description: Lead the organization as part of the governing body responsible for strategy and oversight.

title: Community Engagement Volunteer
description: Participate in community events, science nights, and tabling to share the organization's conservation work with the public.

title: Stop the Bleed Ambassador
description: Support Stop the Bleed trauma-response training and blood donation initiatives at community events, working with medical and volunteer management teams.

title: Donor Experience Specialist (Mobile Drives)
description: Enhance the donor experience at mobile blood drives across Western Washington: greeting donors, monitoring post-donation wellness, managing the canteen, and educating donors on blood products.

orgName: Boys And Girls Clubs Of King County
title: Club Support Volunteer
description: Support program staff, mentor a youth, coach a team, help with teen night, tutor a youth, or assist with facility needs at a Club location.

orgName: Boys And Girls Clubs Of King County
title: Athletics Volunteer Coach/Referee
description: Volunteer as a coach or referee for youth sports, from a single tournament day to a full season.

orgName: Boys And Girls Clubs Of King County
title: Club Advisory Board Member
description: Share professional skills or help tell the Club's story to support fundraising and advisory efforts.

orgName: Boys And Girls Clubs Of King County
title: YouthForce College & Career Readiness Volunteer
description: Participate in leadership and career development workshops for teens, or host a company site tour.

title: Classroom & Community Volunteer
description: Volunteer in classrooms, on athletics fields, leading clubs, at school events, or supporting philanthropic efforts. Classroom-specific sign-ups happen in early September; other needs are communicated via the school newsletter throughout the year.

title: Companion Visitor
description: Provide friendly, one-on-one companionship visits to residents and hospice patients at Kline Galland facilities.
contact: Jemilla Goldstein, Director of Volunteer Services, (206) 805-1930

title: Life Enrichment Activity Assistant
description: Help lead or assist activities like bingo, board games, and arts and crafts at the Campus at Seward Park and Mary Schwartz Summit locations.

title: Hospice Support Volunteer
description: Support hospice patients and families through end-of-life journeys, including legacy work and life review conversations.
commitment: One-year minimum after 26-36 hours of orientation training
contact: Jemilla Goldstein, Director of Volunteer Services, (206) 805-1930

title: Event Volunteer
description: Support Cascade PBS events such as advance screenings and filmmaker Q&As, family festivals, and civic events by welcoming guests and assisting with activities and behind-the-scenes tasks.
contact: Ed Lammi, Event Volunteer Coordinator, cpmvolunteers@cascadepbs.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: Youth Tutoring Program Volunteer
description: After-school/evening academic enrichment tutoring for elementary, middle, and high school students from low-income families.
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: Bus Buddy (Thurston County)
description: Companion volunteers teach new riders how to navigate buses and transfer between routes.
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: Chore Volunteer (Snohomish County, 55+)
description: Help elderly and disabled neighbors with household tasks to maintain independence and dignity.
commitment: One evening monthly to several hours weekly
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: Medical Transportation Driver (Lewis, Mason, Thurston Counties)
description: Drivers transport Medicaid recipients to medical appointments.
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: Food Bank Volunteer (Snohomish County, 55+)
description: Check in clients, stock shelves, and assist with food selection at food bank sites.
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

orgName: Catholic Community Services Of Western Washington
title: SHIBA Medicare Education Volunteer (Snohomish County)
description: Trained volunteers help seniors understand Medicare coverage options.
contact: Hollianne Monson, Director of Volunteer Services, HollianneMo@ccsww.org

title: General Volunteer
description: Support Centro Cultural Mexicano's cultural and community programming in Redmond; the org keeps an interest list and notifies people as specific volunteer opportunities open up.

title: Short-Term Veterinary Mission Trip (e.g., Mongolia - Small Animal)
description: Veterinary professionals and students travel on short-term international trips (Mongolia, Cambodia, Ecuador, South Asia, Guatemala, Kenya, Dominican Republic, etc.) to provide veterinary care as part of Christian ministry work.
schedule: 9-16 day trips, various departure dates through end of 2026
requirements: Veterinary background helpful but not always required

title: Station Volunteer (Events & Administrative Support)
description: Volunteers greet attendees at live performances and events, and assist with behind-the-scenes clerical/administrative tasks for the commercial-free classical station.
commitment: Flexible, a few hours or ongoing
